nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances; written in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; decremented in transferFrom, set in approve.
Private mapping counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom, read by condition/ensure.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist checked in ensure().
Private lower bound on transfer amount, set in init.
Private upper bound on transfer amount, set in init.
Private per-address sale count limit, set in init and read by condition.
Address allowed to bypass the sell restriction; set by setTradeAddress.
Private owner address used for privileged checks; set from msg.sender in constructor.
Public total supply set in constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner/UNI pair/tradeAddress/canSale and otherwise calls condition(); core honeypot restriction.
Public payable transferFrom updating allowance, balances and _onSaleNum after ensure() check; contains unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits per sender.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum with unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batch transfer loop; total = _value * _tos.length is unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure().
Payable constructor; mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as authorization principal and as _from in transfer/approve.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); executes arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked arithmetic total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (overflow/underflow).
Unchecked arithmetic token/maxToken * 10**decimals in init (overflow).
Unchecked balance/allowance decrements and increments in transferFrom without SafeMath.

edges.reason: Parameter _from flows into transferFrom body used for allowance, ensure, balance and _onSaleNum updates.
Parameter _to is the credit target of transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount moved by transferFrom.
Parameter _from of ensure is compared against owner/UNI/_UNI/tradeAddress/canSale.
Parameter _to of ensure is compared against owner and UNI.
Parameter _value of ensure is passed to condition().
Parameter _spender becomes the allowance key in approve.
Parameter _value is stored as the allowance in approve.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
Parameter saleNum is assigned to _saleNum in init.
Parameter token feeds the _minSale computation in init.
Parameter maxToken feeds the _maxSale computation in init.
Recipient array _tos is iterated in batchSend.
Parameter _value is credited per recipient in batchSend.
Parameter addr is written to tradeAddress.
Local total is consumed by batchSend to check the sender balance.
Loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
Local _UNI pair address is used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
token participates in token*(10**decimals) overflow-prone multiplication in init.
maxToken participates in maxToken*(10**decimals) overflow-prone multiplication in init.
_value is a multiplicand of _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
_tos.length multiplies _value in the unchecked total computation.
_value is subtracted from allowance and balanceOf without SafeMath.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as spender in the allowance check and decrement of transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender is forwarded as _from by transfer.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
Constructor sets unlimited allowance for the UNI router.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each recipient.
ensure reads tradeAddress in the whitelist condition.
ensure reads _saleNum indirectly through condition().
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a bypass flag.
ensure compares _from/_to against owner.
condition reads and compares against _saleNum.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
delegate executes the delegatecall unsafe operation.
batchSend computes the unchecked total.
init performs the unchecked bound multiplications.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
delegatecall transfers execution to an attacker-supplied address in this contract's context, allowing reentrant control flow and storage corruption.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the source account operand of the transferFrom implementation.
_to is only meaningful as the destination operand of the transferFrom implementation.
_value is the unchecked arithmetic operand that drives the balance and allowance decrements.
_from exists only for the whitelist comparison performed inside ensure.
_to exists only for the whitelist comparison performed inside ensure.
_value is forwarded from ensure to condition and has no independent behavior.
_spender is only the allowance key used by approve.
_value is only the allowance amount written by approve.
Target address a is the delegatecall destination and cannot be separated from that unsafe operation.
Calldata b is the payload executed by the delegatecall.
saleNum only configures the _saleNum state inside init.
token is an unchecked multiplication operand for the _minSale bound.
maxToken is an unchecked multiplication operand for the _maxSale bound.
_tos is only the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
_value participates in the unchecked total multiplication of batchSend.
addr is only the value stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
total is the direct result of the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication.
Loop index i is purely an implementation detail of the batchSend loop.
_UNI is a computed pair address used only inside ensure's whitelist check.
